import json
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter


def stats(text):
    words = text.split()
    cleaned = [re.sub(r"^\W+|\W+$", "", w).lower() for w in words]
    cleaned = [w for w in cleaned if w]
    counts = Counter(cleaned)
    top = max(counts.values(), default=0)
    top_word = next((w for w in cleaned if counts[w] == top), "")
    return {"lines": len(text.splitlines()), "words": len(words), "chars": len(text), "top_word": top_word}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
        print(json.dumps(stats(f.read())))
